topic: Affect or effect? Grammar in 30 seconds

script.title: Affect or effect? Never mix them up again

lines.text: I mix them up in every essay.
Affect is the verb: stress can affect your sleep.
Effect is the noun: the effect of stress is bad sleep.
Kit's tip: think RAVEN. Remember, affect is a verb, effect is a noun.

script.caption: Stop mixing up affect and effect
